messages.subject: Re: Shiny & ggvis
parts:
Here is a working version of your app. I made two changes:

1. sliderInput requires a three numeric arguments
2. Use ggvis_output instead of uiOutput

Note that this app can be made directly from ggvis, by passing input_slider to size

ggvis(mtcars, props(x = ~disp, y = ~mpg, size := input_slider(10, 1000, 20)) +
   layer_point()



runApp(list(
  ui = pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel(""),
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("size", "Area", 10, 1000, 20)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      ggvis_output("my_plot")
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {

gv <- reactive({
      ggvis(mtcars, props(x = ~disp, y = ~mpg, size := input$size)) +
        layer_point()
    })

Here is a working version of your app. I made two changes:

Note that this app can be made directly from ggvis, by passing input_slider to size

    ),
